the program had a significant effect on increasing the use of ORS and zinc among children with diarrhoea in Gujarat, but had no significant impact on the use of ORs or zinc among children with diarrhea in Uttar Pradesh.

the Diarrhea Allevation through zinc and ORS Therapy program (2011-2014) was successful in increasing access to zinc, ORS, and zinc+ORS among children 2-59 months in Gujarat, and to a lesser extent, in Uttar Pradesh (UP) through public and private delivery channels, and that the program did not increase access to zinc, zinc+ORS, and ORS in UP across socioeconomic status.

understanding the impact of a large–scale public–private partnership program in India that was designed to reduce child mortality and morbidity due to diarrhea through the provision of zinc and ORT.
the question: does zinc help children in India?
understanding the impact of a public health intervention on health equity, in particular, on the extent to which the intervention is able to reach the poor.
